flags: The official brochure gives 37 miles; material maps 40.2 miles beginning at Fairview, while the official route description begins at Hendrysburg. Use the official endpoint and length; mapped alignment needs reconciliation. The brochure’s extracted columns interleave, so the mileage evidence preserves that text verbatim.
No construction date, designation date or drive time is supplied. Terrain detail is limited to hills, valleys and documented farm sites.
Dysart Woods is retained, but its kind is changed to separate excursion rather than promising a short walk. The cache lacks a current manager access statement.

Dropped the current Dysart Woods claim that half the old-growth trees died within a year after 2010 mining: a secondary page asserts the causal link but no scientific study or manager assessment is cached. Do not combine the tourism layer’s old-tree descriptions with that claim as a verified present-condition account.

Dropped the relative age of the Centerville whip maker’s home because the undated source’s 150 years cannot be anchored. Omitted mid-1800s viaduct dating because the tourism layer conflicts with the 1871 opening in the Bellaire page, which itself contains an impossible 1853/1857 railroad chronology.

Woodside, Dysart and Scatterday retain their exact titles and coordinates, ordered west to east against the supplied strip towns. New viaduct moment has no coordinates because there is no dedicated Wikipedia cache page with a COORDINATES line. Woodside, Scatterday and viaduct stories stay short rather than adding unrelated facts.
Roadside visibility does not establish property access at Woodside or Scatterday; no entry or interior visit is promised.
